title: Privometry key set v1
description: The public keys each signing role may use, with validity windows. The sensor ships a pinned root key set; rotations arrive as a new key set (DSSE payloadType application/vnd.privometry.keyset+json) signed by a current root key. Devices reject a key set whose version is not higher than the one they hold.

role.description: publisher keys sign community rule and detector packs; their name is the publisher, the first part of the pack IDs they may sign. A publisher distributes its keys as a key set of publisher keys, which people trust with privometry trust add; publisher keys never appear in a region's key set.

not_after.description: Signatures are rejected after this time; absent means no end.

region.description: For policy keys: the region whose policy service holds the key, for example in.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64.
